mapper.select: SELECT id, alarm_id, classroom_id, device_id, alarm_type, level, detail, action_taken, status, handled_by, handled_at, created_at FROM alarms WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, alarm_id, classroom_id, device_id, alarm_type, level, detail, action_taken, status, handled_by, handled_at, created_at FROM alarms WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowSecond} SECOND) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarms (alarm_id, classroom_id, device_id, alarm_type, level, detail, action_taken) VALUES (#{alarmId}, #{classroomId}, #{deviceId}, #{alarmType}, #{level}, #{detail}, #{actionTaken})
mapper.update: UPDATE alarms SET status = 1, handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
